newsitem.title: USA: American, China Eastern set code sharing.
newsitem.headline: American, China Eastern set code sharing.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines on Wednesday said it signed a memorandum of understanding with China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd to create a reciprocal code-sharing program.

American said it would place its designator code on China Eastern's non-stop trans-Pacific flights between both Beijing and Shanghai and San Francisco, as well as on China Eastern's planned flights between Beijing and Shanghai and Los Angeles.
China Eastern would place its designator on selected American flights between Los Angeles and New York Kennedy, Chicogo O'Hare, Washington Dulles and Dallas/Fort Worth, the company said.
China Eastern would also place its designator on selected American flights between San Francisco and Kennedy and O'Hare, the company said.
The airlines would apply soon for regulatory approval in the United States and China, it said.
